decisions.decision: Material Skin MTL_icon_ convention for home icons instead of custom PNGs
decisions.rationale: Material Skin replaces PNG icons with theme-aware Vuetify icons via MTL_icon_ prefix. Top Tracks was already mapped to trophy SVG via icon-map.json. Our custom PNGs rendered as raw greyscale on all themes. MTL_icon_ history and auto_awesome give automatic light/dark adaptation.

decisions.decision: WR-04 (search offset ceiling) deferred as non-blocking
decisions.rationale: Search feeds near Spotify's 1000-offset ceiling waste one API call but correctness is preserved via JVL-06 error clamp. Efficiency optimization, not a bug.
